action.rationale: Fresh 10D problem with full budget 2000 and cheap, deterministic evaluations; per principle, we first probe (~12% ≈ 240 evals) to learn landscape structure. This seeds the archive and guides method choice before committing to an optimizer.

Probes indicate a smooth, near-quadratic single basin (P3 r2_quad_full=0.982, r2_quad_sep=0.942; P5 cosine=1.0), and L-BFGS-B already made large gains (P4 y_end best=4871.6 from starts at 12702–46628 in ~32 evals each). With 70 stall evals since the last improvement, a focused L-BFGS-B polish from the incumbent should quickly drive further down.

Probes indicate a near-quadratic, smooth landscape (P3 r2_quad_full=0.982), and L-BFGS-B has achieved a 4716 improvement over 300 evals with exhausted=false. With stall_evals=2 and cheap, deterministic evaluations, continuing LBFGSB for another round should further reduce 155.38 or confirm convergence.

Probes indicate a near-quadratic, smooth landscape (P3 r2_quad_full=0.982, FDC=0.7667). L-BFGS-B is slowing (stall_evals=14; only 1.45 improvement from 155.382 to 153.937 last round), so a trust-region quadratic model like BOBYQA may squeeze further gains efficiently. Polishing from the incumbent should not discard progress.

BOBYQA just improved the incumbent to 150.553 with 3.384 gain over its 200-eval tenure and reports not exhausted; stall_evals is 0. Probes indicate a smooth near-quadratic landscape (P3 r2_quad_full=0.982), so continued local trust-region progress is expected.

BOBYQA just improved the incumbent to 149.4226 at eval 938 (stall_evals=0) and reports not exhausted, with 4.51 improvement over its 300-eval tenure. Probes indicate a strongly quadratic, smooth landscape (P3 r2_quad_full=0.982), which suits BOBYQA’s trust-region steps. With 1062 evals left and diminishing but steady gains last round, continuing is the most efficient next step.

Probes indicate a near-quadratic, smooth landscape (P3 r2_quad_full=0.982, FDC=0.767), favoring gradient-based local refinement. BOBYQA’s gains are tapering (best 149.164; ~0.26 improvement last round; 4.77 over 400 evals), so L-BFGS-B from the incumbent should exploit curvature more efficiently now.

LBFGSB gained only 0.014 over its last 200 evals (best 149.1500), suggesting near-convergence. Probes indicate a smooth near-quadratic landscape (r2_quad_full=0.982), so CMA-ES and TuRBO may still locate a slightly better basin; with 762 evals left we can afford a 300-eval hedge to pick the strongest mover. This race balances local refinement against broader exploration before final polishing.

LBFGSB is exhausted and we have stalled for 10 evals with the best stuck at 149.15 since ~1139. With 607 evals left and probes indicating a smooth but not strictly single-basin landscape (P2 top10_spread_vs_uniform=0.7805), a diverse CMA-ES restart (larger population) is appropriate to seek a new basin before final polishing.

CMA-ES used 100 evals with 0 improvement and stall_evals is 110, so it’s time to switch. Probes indicate a near-quadratic landscape (P3 r2_quad_full=0.982), and L-BFGS-B currently holds the best value at 149.15, making it the right tool to refine the incumbent. We’ll polish from the incumbent to try squeezing out any remaining decrease.

The active lbfgsb is exhausted (exhausted=true) after 33 evals in tenure with only 8.16e-09 improvement, and we’ve stalled for 143 evals at 149.1500001. With 474 evals left in 10D, a diverse TuRBO restart is the best bet to explore new basins (it reached 151.161 in 50 evals during the race) before a potential final polish.

Turbo used 100 evals with 0 improvement (stall_evals=243), while the landscape appears near-quadratic (P3 r2_quad_full=0.982). L-BFGS-B already exhausted after 633 evals at 149.1500001, so a BOBYQA polish from the incumbent may squeeze out small gains.

Best value has plateaued at 149.15 since eval 1328 (stall_evals=443), and the active bobyqa improved only 5.8e-08 over 200 evals. Both lbfgsb (633 evals) and bobyqa (600 evals) have effectively converged on a near-quadratic landscape (P3 r2_quad_full=0.982). With only 174 evals left, further gains are unlikely, so we finish early.
